a.xlink:title: Returns the encoded P-field + T-field size without validating the layout.
Decodes one complete numeric CUC value from caller-owned bytes.
Decodes one complete PUS-A TM secondary header.
Decodes one complete PUS-C TM secondary header.
Encodes one numeric CUC value directly into caller-owned storage.
Encodes a numeric CUC value in network byte order.
Returns exact encoded size for valid PUS-A TM tailoring, otherwise zero.
Returns exact encoded size for valid PUS-C TM tailoring, otherwise zero.
Returns the encoded P-field plus T-field size.
Decodes one complete CUC value using the declared layout.
Encodes one PUS-A TM secondary header into caller-owned storage.
Encodes one PUS-C TM secondary header into caller-owned storage.
